# Codex brief: Knowledge & Safety teaching scenes (28 November 2026)

Read `docs/teaching-scenes/BRIEF.md` first. This job makes the 15 teaching scenes for Mammals.

**Work one picture at a time.** If a picture comes out wrong, re-render it whole. Do not edit any file outside `docs/teaching-scenes/originals/`.

Size: **1536 × 1024 landscape** (the tool's landscape size). Claude cuts it to 1200 × 800, so keep anything important away from the outer 3% of the frame. The whole frame is filled: no transparency, border or frame.

## Rules for every scene

- Show the situation, not the answer: no arrows, ticks, crosses, words, letters, signs with writing, logos or watermarks.
- No child touches a wild animal. Children appear only far off or seen from behind, with no faces in close-up.
- The animal named in the scene is clear and easy to find at a small size; one main subject, a calm, uncluttered background.
- British countryside, gardens and coast (UK species only), soft natural daylight unless the line says otherwise.

## Style paragraph (put it first in every prompt)

Style R (realistic, as the Mammals word pictures):

```text
Educational teaching scene for Mammal Discovery Club, a science game for ages 4–7. One wide landscape photograph, lifelike and natural, like a gentle nature photo: soft natural light, natural colours, sharp main subject with a softly blurred background, calm and friendly mood, nothing scary. The full frame is filled edge to edge. No text, letters, signs, arrows, symbols, logos, watermark, border or frame. Children appear only far off or from behind, never touching an animal.
```

Style P (painted, as the Insects teaching scenes in `E:/Projects/Codex/insects-weekly-game/assets/teaching-scenes/`, style only):

```text
Educational teaching scene for Mammal Discovery Club, a science game for ages 4–7. One wide landscape illustration in soft traditional watercolour and coloured pencil on warm paper, gentle storybook look, natural colours, calm and friendly mood, nothing scary. The full frame is filled edge to edge. No text, letters, signs, arrows, symbols, logos, watermark, border or frame. Children appear only far off or from behind, never touching an animal.
```

## Style chosen

Owner, 28 Nov 2026: **style R (realistic)** for all 15, after a pilot of wild-big in both styles. wild-big is done (`ks-wild-big.png`); the painted pilot is kept as `pilot-ks-wild-big-painted.png`. Use style R for every other scene.

## Checks before delivering

- Look at each picture: no text or letters anywhere, no faces in close-up, no child near an animal, the named animal correct for the UK (red or roe deer, grey seal, European hedgehog, grey squirrel).
- The frame is filled and the subject sits inside the 1200 × 800 safe area.
